info.text:
A 1-carat natural diamond has lost half its value since 2021.

CNBC (Sept 2026): average 1-carat stone $8,007 in 2021, $3,898 as of September 2026.
De Beers' average rough price fell 7% to $142 a carat in 2025.
Lab-grown went from 12% of engagement rings in 2019 to 61% in 2025 (The Knot). Their wholesale prices fell about 74% since 2020.
Natural sells rarity. Lab-grown sells price.

Sources: CNBC (Sept 26, 2026), De Beers 2025 results, The Knot, Edahn Golan Diamond Research.
News and education, not financial advice.
